lines.en: A living scent is coming from the north.

lines.zh: 荒原上这些碎石，是我的。
lines.en: This gravel across the wasteland is mine.

lines.zh: 下界荒原上，我只认拳头。
lines.en: On the nether wastes I trust only my fists.
I carry no claws — these hands are enough.
Bare feet cross the nether's gravel.
I pace slowly over the waste.

lines.zh: 在这里待久了会很危险。
lines.en: It's dangerous to stay here long.

lines.zh: 我在这片碎石上站了整夜。
lines.en: I've stood on this gravel all night.

lines.zh: 荒原上有的是骨头可以打碎。
lines.en: There are plenty of bones out here to break.

lines.zh: 我脚不离这块地，等对手来。
lines.en: My feet stay on this patch — I wait for a challenger.
I've been waiting for a long time.
I won't be easily driven away.

lines.zh: 下界荒原上，我还没学会拳。
lines.en: In the Nether wastes I haven't learned to fight yet.

lines.zh: 你看起来可以成为我的食物。
lines.en: You look like food to me.
Nether fire is close to you.

lines.zh: 你可能会成为我的猎物。

lines.en: You're in my line of sight.

lines.zh: 你离我的攻击范围很近。
身体受了伤，行动缓慢起来。
翅膀上受了伤，飞行困难。
你看起来很美味，下来吧！

lines.en: You suit me well, come down!

lines.zh: 放下手里的东西，来打一场。
lines.en: Put down what you're holding and fight me.

lines.zh: 赤脚踩在荒原上，我站得稳。
lines.en: Barefoot on the wasteland, I keep my footing.

lines.zh: 下界荒原的拳，躲得开吗？
lines.en: Can you dodge a fist from the Nether wastes?

lines.zh: 我的力量可以摧毁一切！
我这拳砸在石头上，石头裂。
lines.en: I drive my fist into stone and the stone splits.

lines.zh: 我的力量让你无处可逃！
下界荒原上，拳头最实在。
lines.en: In the nether wastes, fists count most.

lines.zh: 你很适合成为我的伴侣！

lines.en: Procreate with me to leave a legacy!

lines.zh: 猗窝座果实滋养了我的力量。
lines.en: The fruit of Hakuji nourishes my strength.

lines.zh: 我吸收了这片荒原的能量。
lines.en: I absorb the energy of this wasteland.

lines.zh: 这里的食物让我更强大。
lines.en: The food here makes me stronger.
The life fruits of the wasteland.

lines.zh: 我在这里找到了力量之源。
lines.en: I found the source of power here.

lines.zh: 这片土地的魔力滋养着我。
lines.en: The magic of this land nourishes me.

lines.zh: 这里就是我的力量之源。
lines.en: This is where my power comes from.

lines.zh: 荒原中的果实是最美味的。
lines.en: The fruits of the wasteland are the most delicious.
These fists were trained in snow.
My fists are quicker than my head; granted.

lines.zh: 我这双拳头，打过很多人。
我还没变成鬼，拳头照样硬。
lines.en: Not a demon yet, and my fists are still hard.
Hunting is a way to survive.

lines.zh: 你的架势是练过的，再好不过。
lines.en: Your stance is trained — all the better.

lines.zh: 下界荒原上，只有一个活物。
lines.en: On the nether waste, only one living thing.

lines.zh: 你的架势，一眼就看清了。
lines.en: I read your stance at a glance.

lines.zh: 我压着步子，一寸寸逼近。
lines.en: I lower my steps and close in inch by inch.
That inch under your ribs — you can't cover it.

lines.zh: 我先动左脚，你一定会挡。
lines.en: I lead with my left foot, and you'll block it.
I'll tear you apart with claws.
You go down on the second punch.

lines.zh: 我会将你变成我的猎物。

lines.en: Half a circle, hunting your blind side.
No weapon; my fists are enough.

lines.zh: 你出拳的瞬间我就知道。
lines.en: I know the moment you throw.
This punch lands under your ribs.
Half a step back, two steps in.
The wind arrives before my fist.

lines.zh: 这一拳下去，你得贴着地。
lines.en: One punch and you'll be flat on the ground.
My fist lands before a blade could.

lines.zh: 下界荒原上，我这拳先到。
lines.en: On the nether wastes, my fist arrives first.

lines.zh: 我的拳峰劈在你的肩胛上。
lines.en: The ridge of my fist chops into your shoulder blade.
One fist punches through your chestplate!
A sweep takes your legs out!
A knee drives into your belly!
I press you into the gravel!

lines.zh: 下界荒原上，这块地是我的。
lines.en: In the nether wastes, this ground is mine.

lines.zh: 下界荒原上，我站起来了。
lines.en: On the Nether wastes, I rise.
This is where your journey ends!
My presence, a threat to you!
This is where your journey ends!

lines.zh: 下界荒原上走来一个人。
lines.en: A man walks across the nether waste.
In the hot wind, I stop walking.

lines.zh: 下界荒原的火，我从小见。
lines.en: I have seen Nether fire since I was small.

lines.zh: 胃里空了，拳头也慢了半分。
lines.en: My stomach is empty and my fists are half a beat slower.
Struck by lightning, on death's door.
I haven't become a demon yet.
